posts.author: Geola
posts.content_md:
New VRP-M (green-sensitive) film is made for Geola by Slavich. New film coating facility has been established and some film defects that been occurring previously (such as major scratches, visible dust parts and bad flatness) are now gone.

The new film is clean, flat and has a new package, which is very convenient for multiplex use.

In regard to these good news, we are offering you a free samples of a new VRP-M film - just send us ([info@geola.com](mailto:info@geola.com)) or your distributor (listed bellow) 

your mailing address and we will ship 3 film sample sheets (102x127mm size) for free.

Give it a try and make it certain !

(Film of other types of emulsions (PFG-01 and PFG-03C) is coming soon - we will test it and if the results are satisfying, 

will offer you some free samples too)

Get your free sample from your distributor:

(Just send you mailing address and ask for a free VRP-M film samples)

posts.author: ron olson
posts.content_md:
I was able to run a test on the new GEOLA green sensitive film and can report excellent results. Good brightness and contrast - very clean material.

How funny that everyone was cursing a few years back about the imminent demise of holographic films. I can now choose between several excellent suppliers and more are on the way.
